Our roots

Three decades of growing green

Fernwood Botanicals started as a single backyard greenhouse and a stubborn belief that everyone can keep a plant alive with the right start.

Est. 1994

From one greenhouse to a thriving nursery

What began in 1994 as Marisol Fern's backyard hobby — a lean-to greenhouse and a dozen propagation trays — has grown into a beloved neighborhood nursery on the edge of Mossvale. We still grow the way Marisol did: slowly, by hand, and with a deep respect for each plant's natural rhythm.

We don't flood our benches with mass-grown stock. Every plant that leaves Fernwood is acclimated, root-checked, and matched to the home it's heading to. If a plant isn't ready, it doesn't ship.

How we grow

Sustainability, all the way down

Good for your home, gentler on the planet. These aren't add-ons — they're how Fernwood has always worked.

100% peat-free

We grow in renewable coir and composted bark blends — never peat, protecting precious carbon-rich bogs.

Rainwater recovery

Our greenhouse roof feeds a 10,000L cistern, so nearly every drop your plants drink fell from our own sky.

Plastic-light packing

Plants ship in compostable nursery pots and recycled, molded-pulp cradles. Return your pots for store credit.

Solar greenhouse

Our benches and propagation mats run on rooftop solar, with battery backup for those long Oregon winters.
